justification: The assessment gives exactly the reference witness, with the edge labels swapped. The parent plank is compact Hausdorff and hence normal; both edges are disjoint and closed in the deleted plank. Any neighborhood of the right edge contains a tail in each finite row. Their countably many ordinal bounds have supremum below ω₁, so some vertical sequence lies entirely in that neighborhood and converges to the top edge, preventing disjoint open neighborhoods.
